We need to determine relation between two statements. Both are from same actor (same person) but we don't know name. We need to see if they respond to same specific proposition. He talks about need for clean energy, sovereignty, etc. He seems to be discussing tariff adjustments, need for solution, support for lower prices, etc. He doesn't explicitly state stance on a specific proposition like "should increase tariffs" or "should keep tariffs low". He seems to argue for affordable energy, continue work, etc. Likely stance: AGAINST high tariffs (i.e., against current increase). Manifestation B: public hearing about "Participação da Câmara na definição das regras de renovação das concessões das distribuidoras de energia elétrica". He says "modelo atual das concessionárias... é sólido e deve ser preservado." He supports preserving current model. He also says tariff social is responsibility of Union, etc. He seems to be in favor of preserving current concession model, maybe also supportive of current tariffs? He doesn't explicitly state stance on tariff increase. He supports current concession model, says it's solid, should be preserved. That is a stance on a proposition about preserving the model. In A, he is discussing tariff adjustments and need for solution, but not a specific proposition about preserving concession model. So they are not responding to same specific proposition. Both have determinable positions (A: against high tariffs, B: in favor of preserving current concession model). So they are INCOMPARABLE.

Thus relation = INCOMPARABLE.
